title: Relative braid group symmetries on quantum supersymmetric pairs of type sAIII
summary: We introduce the relative Coxeter groupoid and construct intrinsic relative braid group symmetries for quantum supersymmetric pairs of type sAIII. These symmetries are constructed by establishing new intertwining properties of quasi $K$-matrices, which generalize the earlier non-super construction of Wang and the second author. We derive explicit formulas for these symmetries and prove that they satisfy the braid relations in the relative Coxeter groupoid.
